topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I poured my heart into this, day by day, night into early dawn, crafting it with my own hands, mind racing faster than my fingers could move. The gears, the wires, the tiny, intricate parts—all of it, a symphony of innovation. I thought it was mine, a secret kept close, a dream spinning in the silence of my own mind. Then, the letter. A cold, flat page that snuffed out the light. They said it was theirs, already. All my work, my sweat, my hope, shadows cast by their claim. I stand here, the pieces of my project scattered, the sky empty and vast. What now? The path forward is obscured, the air thick with questions, my hands empty.
